# Current state has arrow cross showing (5 grays). Click arrow center to execute jump.
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 19, 'col': 24}])

seg = current_frame.segmentation
greens = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
grays = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] in ['G', 'g', 'c']]
purples = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] in ['M', 'P', 'p']]
print(f"After jump: Greens={len(greens)}, Grays={len(grays)}, Purples={len(purples)}")
print(f"Result: done={last_action_result.get('done')}, level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}, board_changed={last_action_result.get('board_changed')}")

if purples:
    for p in purples:
        b = p['boundary']
        min_r = min(r for r, c in b)
        min_c = min(c for r, c in b)
        print(f"  Purple at ({min_r},{min_c})")
    # Try moving purple character RIGHT
    action(['RIGHT'])
    seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
    purples2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] in ['M', 'P', 'p']]
    if purples2:
        p2 = purples2[0]
        b2 = p2['boundary']
        min_r2 = min(r for r, c in b2)
        min_c2 = min(c for r, c in b2)
        print(f"After RIGHT: Purple at ({min_r2},{min_c2})")
        print(f"Board changed: {last_action_result.get('board_changed')}")

</function>
